text: [{"name":"Open Bank Project: AI agent and MCP access to OBP-API","summary":"OBP-API is an open-source banking REST API platform (600+ endpoints, 14 API versions) used by banks, fintechs and regulators; Marko is one of its two lead contributors with 4,500+ commits. He designed how AI reaches it: the Opey agent and the OBP MCP server call OBP-API with the user's token forwarded agent → MCP → API, OAuth 2.1 discovery and PKCE for external MCP clients, and built the API side (token and consent validation, entitlement checks, session and state endpoints).","tech":["Scala","http4s","Java","Spring Boot","PostgreSQL"],"id":"obp-api","url":"https://github.com/OpenBankProject/OBP-API","role":"lead contributor (since 2017)","cv":true},{"name":"OBP Keycloak Provider (Keycloak User Storage SPI over the OBP API)","summary":"Open-source Keycloak User Storage SPI that lets Keycloak authenticate Open Bank Project users through OBP's REST API instead of touching its database: user lookup and credential verification are delegated to OBP endpoints, only users of a configured provider are accepted, admin tokens are cached and refreshed, and OBP users stay read-only in Keycloak. Works alongside brokered identity providers such as Google. Java 17, Docker, Maven, PostgreSQL, CI/CD scripts and OBP-themed login pages.
